paite: Horeb tang a akiang ua thu akhun sim louh, TOUPA'N Moab gam a Israel suante kiang a Mosi thu akhunsak, athukhun thu hiaite ahi.
Mosi in Israel mi tengteng asam a, akiang uah, Aigupta gam a Pharaoh, asikha tengteng leh agam tengteng tung a na mitmuh ngei ua TOUPA'N thil ahih tengteng na mu uhi.
heading: Moab Gam A Israel Toh Kal A Pathian

paite: Khemna thupi mahmahte, chiamtehnate leh thillamdangte na mit mahmah ua na muh uh.
Himahleh TOUPA'N tuni tan in theisiam ding lungtang, mu thei ding mitte, za thei ding bilte ahon pe nai kei hi.
Gamdai ah kum sawmli ka hon pi a; na puansilhte uh na silhtul kei ua, na khedapte uh leng na buntul kei lai uhi.
Kei, TOUPA na Pathian uh ka hi, chih na theihna ding un tanghou na ne kei ua, uain hiam zu khauh hiam leng na dawn kei uhi.
Hiai mun na hong tun un Heshbon kumpipa Sihon leh Bashan kumpipa Og hon dou ding in ahong kuan ua, amau i na zou uh.
Agam uh i la ua, Reubente, Gadte, Manasseh nam kimkhatte luah ding in i pia uhi.
Na thilhih tengteng ua na lamzan zel theihna ding un hiai thukhun thute pom unla, zui un.
Tuni in na vek un, na nam lupente uh, na upate uh, na heutute uh leh Israel mi tengteng, TOUPA na Pathian ma ah na dingh ua;
na taneute uh, na zite uh, na tenna ua gamdangmi na ompih uh, na singphukmi uh leh na tui tawi mite uh nangawn in;
TOUPA na Pathian uh kichiamna leh athukhun tuni a nou toh abawl a na luttheihna ding un:
Na pipute uh Abraham, Isak leh Jakob kiang a ana kichiam bang leh na kiang ua ana gensa bang a amite hi ding a tuni a hon hihkip theihna ding leh na Pathian uh ahihtheihna ding in;
hiai kichiamna leh thukhun na kiang kia ua khung ka hi kei;
tuni a TOUPA i Pathian uh ma a dinghte leh tua i kiang ua omloute kiang ah leng ahi.
Aigupta ota gam a i omdan, namdangte pal paisuak a i paidan bang uh na thei ua;
alak ua athilkihhuaite uleh amilimte uh, sing leh suang, dangka chi leh dangka-eng leng na mu uh.

Huchi lou in zaw na lak ua pasal hiam, numei hiam, inkuan hiam, nam hiam, huai pathiante be ding in alungtang un tu in TOUPA i Pathian uh kiheisan in, na lak uah thil kha leh gamsai selkhiakna bulte na hong om kha ding uh.
Huchi ahihleh zaw, hiai hamsia thu samte azaktak in, amah kivualzawl tawm in, "Paupeng in pai teitei leng le ka bit na ding," chi in akingaihtuah kha ding.
TOUPA'N angaidam het kei dia, TOUPA hehna leh amullitna in huai mi akhuh dia, hiai laibu a hamse tuang tengteng atung ah atung dia, TOUPA'N van nuai a pan amin athaimang zaw ding hi.
Hiai Dan Bu a tuang hamsia thukhun tengteng bang in Israel nam tengteng lak a pan hihtuam in thil hoih lou lam ah TOUPA'N akhenkhe ding hi.
Khangthak hong om ding, na nung ua na tate uh hong om ding leh gam gamlapi a pan a hong pai dingte'n, huai gam a hipi leh TOUPA'N natna aveisakte amu ding uhi.

Agam pumpi mei katsiat leh chi leh kat a dim, haichi lah kipawi lou, bangmah pou lou, sing leh lou bangmah om lou ahi ding. TOUPA heh leh thangpaihna Sodom leh Gomorrah, Admah leh Zeboim alumlet lai a siatna bangmah ahi ding.
"Nam teng in bangziak in ahia hiai gam hichi tel a TOUPA'N abawl? Hiai thangpaihna thupi bangchidan ahia?" achi ding uh.
Mite'n, "Aigupta gam a pan apikhiak lai a TOUPA, apipute uh Pathian thukhun amau toh akhun amangngilh ziak un.
pathian dangte, atheih ngei louh uh pathiante, ama'n asehsak louhte nna sem a, abiak ziak un.
Hiai laibu a tuang hamsia tengteng tungsak ding in hiai gam tung ah TOUPA aheh hi.
Thangpai, heh leh thangpai mahmah in agam ua kipan abotkhe vek a, gamdang ah asawnlut hi, tua a-omdan bang uh," achi ding uhi.
Thil kiselte TOUPA i Pathian a ahi, thil kiphoulakte bel hiai dan thu tengteng i zuihtheihna dia eite leh i suante a ahi gige ding ahi.
